description: What the checks of the gate said about a tree, run now or stored from an earlier run.

id.description: The first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the tree hash, the checks and the runner mode. The result is stored in .agent-fox/gate/<id>/.

tree.description: The tree hash the checks ran on.

table_source.description: Where the table of checks came from.

cached.description: Whether the result was stored and no check ran.

passed.description: True only when at least one check ran and every check that ran passed.

checks.description: The checks that ran, in table order.

status.description: pass: exit 0; fail: another exit code; error: the program could not start; timeout: the check outlived its deadline and was stopped.

exit_code.description: -1 when the check has none: it did not start, or was stopped.

log.description: The full output of the check, relative to --dir.

tail.description: The last 40 lines of the output, at most 4096 bytes.

skipped.description: The checks that did not run.

reason.description: unavailable: the program cannot be run on this machine.
